props.description: A split-screen animation with two matplotlib histograms rendered side by side. The left histogram ('Before') starts fully visible: gray background, boxed border, tiny axis labels, no density curve. The right histogram ('After') begins as a ghost overlay of the left, then frame-by-frame each element transforms: background fades from gray to white, gridlines appear as thin horizontal lines, the top and right spines dissolve away, font sizes visibly grow, a KDE curve rises over the bars. Labels 'Default Matplotlib' and 'Styled Seaborn' sit below each panel in matching caption typography. The transformation completes with a soft glow pulse on the styled right side, then both panels hold for 2 seconds.
